title: Selectively visible lights over valley on Highway 40
summary: Steve tells of Selectively visible lights over valley on Highway 40, about unspecified at Highway 40 en route to Bullhead City, Arizona, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Highway 40 en route to Bullhead City, Arizona

tellings.quote: Another time, um, my son and I were, uh, driving to our old vacation place in Bullhead City, Arizona, and we were on Highway 40, out in a remote area, and, um, I saw this, uh, this bright white light hovering over this valley about 5 or 10 miles away.

plain: A man named Steve says that once, while driving with his son on Highway 40 through a remote stretch toward their old vacation spot in Bullhead City, Arizona, he saw a bright white light hovering over a valley about 5 to 10 miles away. The story is told as one where the lights seemed to show themselves to some people and not others, and a person named Garrett is part of his account.
